title: 第十章 归尘进城
content_zh:
芊芊的突然杀入，让厌火出现短暂的混乱。可厌火们很快地发现了，芊芊空有强大的攻击力，却杂乱无章，完全是随心所欲，有时候对旁边的不管不问，却去攻击距离很远的厌火。

    利用祸斗受伤，停止攻击的间隙，尘小楼双手一挥，一股冰冷刀意朝厌火袭去。

    雨归尘则凌空飘起，牵住尘小楼，落到墨非夜身边。要不是墨攻行的蜘蛛，刺伤祸斗，两人就会一直被那手持镰刀的厌火纠缠，难以脱身。

    由于坐骑受伤，那名厌火也并未追击，只是恶狠狠额看了墨攻行一眼，一声大吼。

    一群厌火骑兵蜂拥而出，将几人围在了中间，相对普通的厌火，骑兵们的战斗方式更加有章法。

    他们零零散散地分布在四周，会利用祸斗的机动性，不停地在远处骚扰，如果你攻击他们，那被攻击的就会四处逃窜，而其余的继续攻击。

    火球越来越多，墨非夜和墨攻行两人，在尘小楼的帮助下，只能勉强应付，根本没法出手。尘小楼倒是可以用刀气反击，可以骑兵速度太快，而尘小楼的动作又太笨拙。

    唯一有能力的芊芊，却在骑兵的引诱下，绕圈圈绕的不亦说乎，对其他厌火完全不闻不问。

    时间越久，对众人就越不利，因为元气终究会被耗尽。

    “你们保护我一下。”雨归尘说道。

    墨非夜和墨攻行两人想到在吴鹿城时，尘小楼与巨蛇对战时候的场景，当时尘小楼打伤巨蛇时的那一下，雨归尘就是犹如入定般，当时就是几个金甲力士帮她抗下巨蛇的攻击。

    “等一下。”墨攻行不好意思地说道：“我俩的实力，怕是扛不住，还是要芊芊过来，看行不行。”

    “芊芊，芊芊。”墨攻行对着芊芊喊道。

    芊芊还沉浸在捉迷藏，绕圈圈的游戏中不能自拔，对墨攻行的叫喊置若罔闻。

    “芊芊，你的夜要走了。”墨攻行没办法只能使出大招。

    白影一闪，芊芊出现在墨非夜眼前。

    “我的夜，你要去哪？”芊芊盯着墨非夜的眼睛问道。

    墨非夜头一偏，装成什么都不知道。

    “死胖子，你干什么？”芊芊眉头一皱，转过头对墨攻行抱怨道，眼睛的余光正好扫到雨归尘，连忙跑到雨归尘跟前惊叹道：“好漂亮的姐姐，简直和画里的人一样，身段怎么这么好？”

    雨归尘明显对这种热情不适应，可芊芊身上笼罩的元气，说明了芊芊的实力。雨归尘站着一动不动，而尘小楼则缓缓地升起，漂浮在半空中。

    “哇。”芊芊还没来得及发出感慨，就听到墨攻行说道：“雨姑娘现在不能动，你快点保护她。”

    “小问题。”芊芊身上的元气开始晕转，覆盖在身上的狐狸状元气，犹如波浪一样朝尾巴涌去，身后六尾开始迅速膨胀变大，然后展开将场中的众人罩住，抵挡住火球的攻击。

    清冷磅礴的刀气从尘小楼体内蜂拥而出，围绕在他身边，形成一股旋风，将身边的火焰全部斩碎。
content_en:
Qianqian's sudden attack caused a brief confusion in Yanhuo. The disgusting fires quickly discovered that Qianqiankong had strong attack power, but was disorganized and completely did whatever he wanted. Sometimes he would ignore those next to him and attack the disgusting fires that were far away.

    Taking advantage of the moment when Fu Dou was injured and stopped attacking, Chen Xiaolou waved his hands, and a cold sword intent struck at Yan Huo.

    Yu Guichen floated up in the sky, held Chen Xiaolou, and landed next to Mo Feiye. If Mo Gongxing's spider hadn't stabbed Fu Dou, the two of them would have been entangled with the sickle-wielding Yan Huo, making it difficult to escape.

    Because his mount was injured, the Yanhuo did not pursue him, but gave Mo Gongxing a vicious look and roared.

    A group of fire-weary cavalry swarmed out and surrounded several people. Compared with the ordinary fire-weary cavalry, the cavalry's fighting method was more organized.

    They are scattered around and will use Fu Dou's mobility to constantly harass you from a distance. If you attack them, the attacked ones will run away while the rest continue to attack.

    There were more and more fireballs. Mo Feiye and Mo Gongxing, with the help of Chen Xiaolou, could only cope with it and were unable to take action at all. Chen Xiaolou could counterattack with sword energy, but the cavalry was too fast, and Chen Xiaolou's movements were too clumsy.

    Qianqian, the only capable one, was lured by the cavalry and walked around in circles, completely indifferent to the other Yanhuo.

    The longer it takes, the worse it will be for everyone, because the energy will eventually be exhausted.

    "Protect me." Yu Guichen said.

    Mo Feiye and Mo Gongxing thought of the scene in Wulucheng when Chen Xiaolou fought against the giant snake. When Chen Xiaolou injured the giant snake, Yu Guichen felt as if she was in trance. At that time, several golden armored warriors helped her resist the attack of the giant snake.

    "Wait a minute." Mo Gongxing said sheepishly: "I'm afraid we two are not strong enough to handle it, so I'd better ask Qianqian to come over and see if he can do it."

    "Qianqian, Qianqian." Mo Gongxing shouted to Qianqian.

    Qianqian was still immersed in the game of hide and seek, unable to extricate herself, and turned a deaf ear to Mo Gongxing's shouts.

    "Qianqian, your night is about to end." Mo Gengxing had no choice but to use his ultimate move.

    The white shadow flashed, and Qianqian appeared in front of Mo Feiye.

    "My night, where are you going?" Qianqian asked, staring into Mo Feiye's eyes.

    Mo Feiye tilted his head and pretended not to know anything.

    "Damn fat man, what are you doing?" Qianqian frowned, turned around and complained to Mo Gongxing, her peripheral vision happened to catch Yu Guichen, she quickly ran to Yu Guichen and exclaimed: "Such a beautiful sister, just like the person in the painting, why is her figure so good?"

    Yu Guichen was obviously not used to this kind of enthusiasm, but the vitality surrounding Qianqian's body showed Qianqian's strength. Yu Guichen stood motionless, while Chen Xiaolou slowly rose and floated in mid-air.

    "Wow." Before Qianqian could express her emotion, she heard Mo Gengxing say: "Miss Yu can't move now, hurry up and protect her."

    "Small problem." The vitality on Qianqian's body began to faint, and the fox-shaped vitality covering her body surged toward the tail like a wave. The six tails behind her began to expand rapidly, and then spread out to cover everyone in the field, resisting the attack of the fireball.

    The cold and majestic sword energy swarmed out of Chen Xiaolou's body and surrounded him, forming a whirlwind and chopping up all the flames around him.
title_en: Chapter 10 Gui Chen enters the city
